training_data.provenance_note: Training labels (stress_level / stress_type) are simulation labels, not biological ground truth. Metrics are synthetic-data metrics and are not experimentally validated plant-health performance.

split.note: Train rows are strictly earlier than test rows; features use past rows only.

score_convention: anomaly_score = -IsolationForest.decision_function(x). HIGHER = MORE anomalous. is_anomaly = anomaly_score > 0 (decision threshold 0.0, set by the contamination fraction on the training data). Scores are relative to training data and are not probabilities.

metrics_vs_helper_label.note: Evaluated against synthetic helper labels (is_synthetic_anomaly); the label was never a model input.

note: An anomaly flag means 'unusual combination of readings' - possibly a sensor / wiring / data-quality problem or an unusual environment. It is NOT a plant-health prediction.
known_limitations: Flags unusual reading combinations (often sensor issues); not a plant-health predictor.
Contamination is a configured assumption, not an estimate of the true anomaly rate.
